title: Import the full EPP workspace corpus
goal: Bring the full app-facing EPP corpus, project metadata, extracted source context, and retained regulatory sources into a standalone Archivist workspace without preserving development-only original source-files as app content.
acceptance_criteria: A repeatable import script can rebuild the full EPP workspace from the original repo
The imported workspace manifest includes every catalog document from the EPP project catalog
Project metadata needed for navigation, search, compliance, placeholders, retained regulatory sources, artifacts, and requirements is copied with the workspace after app-facing sanitization
Extracted source context is retained only when it is app-facing and sanitized, or when it supports retained regulatory/CFR/Survey Guidance views
Regulatory source files under sources/regulatory are retained because they feed viewed and used CFR and Survey Guidance content
Original office/catalog source files under source-files are physically removed from workspaces/epp-full during refresh and are not retained in the app-facing workspace

Development-only original source annotations under extracts/source-annotations are removed or normalized so original office/catalog file names, source_path fields, and source-file semantics are not retained as app-facing extracted context
workspaces/epp-full/project/catalog.json is normalized in place as app-facing metadata rather than preserved as a raw upstream catalog copy

All app-facing project metadata copied into workspaces/epp-full/project is sanitized so development-only original office/catalog source paths do not leak through crosswalks, source metadata, search metadata, compliance metadata, or future service responses

Original source records in project/catalog.json are normalized to minimal non-browseable provenance stubs that preserve source IDs and human labels without original file paths, open targets, download targets, or retained-file semantics
Document source_ids remain stable for traceability, but source_ids for development-only originals resolve only to non-browseable provenance
Archivist v1 does not retain a separate raw original catalog copy containing development-only source file paths
App-facing workspace metadata does not expose absolute local paths to the original EPP source checkout; source_reference may retain source kind, branch, commit, and a non-browseable human label
Refreshed workspace metadata no longer advertises original source-files paths, copied counts, or missing-source-file counts as app-facing workspace data

A repeatable post-import leak check fails if app-facing workspace metadata or extracted context contains disallowed development-only source markers such as .docx, .xlsx, .xls, source-files, source_path, original_source_files_path, copied_original_source_files, missing_original_source_files, or raw open/download target fields outside retained regulatory source data

A repeatable post-cleanup reference-integrity check fails if retained app-facing metadata points to removed source annotations, removed source-files paths, removed raw source paths, or unresolved development-only source records
Any reference affected by cleanup is either rewritten to a retained document/source/regulatory ID or normalized provenance stub, or the import fails with a clear report
Workspace import summaries use explicit count fields such as document_count, provenance_source_count, and retained_regulatory_source_count instead of a generic source_count
Importer console output and future service-facing workspace summaries use explicit labels that distinguish retained regulatory sources from provenance-only source records
The post-import leak check intentionally excludes canonical Markdown document bodies under workspaces/epp-full/content because SG-0007 does not rewrite retained canonical content
Normal import refresh preserves app-owned state such as audit/ledger.jsonl, approved workbook-state sidecars, draft workbook state, and runtime data unless a future explicit reset command is used
Missing workbook sidecars may be seeded non-destructively, but existing approved or draft workbook state is not overwritten during normal import refresh
Successful normal import refresh appends one sanitized import event to audit/ledger.jsonl and prints a matching console summary

Import audit events include explicit counts, validation statuses, preserved-state status, seeded-sidecar counts, and source commit/branch provenance without raw source paths, development-only filenames, source-files paths, source_path values, browse targets, or download targets

Import refresh builds a candidate epp-full workspace in a non-app-facing staging area and promotes imported surfaces into workspaces/epp-full only after source-leak and reference-integrity checks pass
Failed candidate import or validation leaves the existing live workspaces/epp-full usable and does not append a success import audit event
The seed workspace remains available for fast scaffold testing
non_goals: Rendering every imported document in the React UI in this slice
Porting all artifact widgets in this slice
Changing canonical Markdown content during import
Scanning canonical Markdown document bodies as part of the SG-0007 source-leak check
Treating mentions of historical worksheet or source file names inside retained canonical Markdown as import-retention failures
Retaining raw upstream catalog copies with development-only source file paths inside the Archivist app workspace
Exposing absolute local original-source checkout paths in app-facing manifests, project metadata, or service responses
Retaining development-only original source annotations as app-facing extracted context
Silently leaving dangling references to removed source annotations or removed original source paths
Using a bare source_count field or message that implies provenance-only source records are retained source files
Removing retained regulatory source metadata needed for CFR and Survey Guidance app views
Resetting audit history, workbook state, draft workbook state, or runtime data during normal import refresh
Writing raw source paths, development-only source filenames, browse targets, or download targets into import audit events
Partially mutating the live epp-full workspace before candidate import validation passes
Discovering or browsing staging import candidates as app workspaces
validation: Run scripts/import_epp_workspace.py
Confirm workspaces/epp-full/workspace.json document_count matches the EPP catalog
Confirm workspaces/epp-full/source-files is absent after refresh
Confirm workspaces/epp-full/project/catalog.json is the normalized app-facing catalog
Confirm no raw original catalog copy with development-only source file paths is retained in the Archivist app workspace
Confirm workspace source_reference keeps source kind, branch, commit, and a non-browseable label without exposing an absolute local source path
Confirm original source records in workspaces/epp-full/project/catalog.json no longer expose original file paths or browse/download targets
Confirm development-only original source annotations under workspaces/epp-full/extracts/source-annotations are absent or normalized without original source_path values
Confirm app-facing project metadata under workspaces/epp-full/project no longer exposes development-only original office/catalog source file paths, including crosswalk metadata
Run the automated post-import source-leak check and confirm it fails on disallowed original-source markers while allowing retained regulatory data under sources/regulatory
Run the post-cleanup reference-integrity check and confirm retained app-facing references resolve to retained documents, retained regulatory sources, or normalized provenance stubs
Confirm source-leak and reference-integrity checks run against the staged candidate before promotion
Confirm failed candidate import or validation leaves the existing live workspaces/epp-full usable and appends no success import audit event
Confirm workspace.json and import output use explicit source count labels rather than a generic source_count
Confirm the leak check scope excludes canonical Markdown bodies under workspaces/epp-full/content
Confirm audit/ledger.jsonl, workbook-state sidecars, draft workbook state, and runtime data are preserved across normal import refresh
Confirm missing workbook sidecars can be seeded without overwriting existing approved or draft sidecars
Confirm a successful import refresh appends one sanitized import event to audit/ledger.jsonl

Confirm the import event and console summary use explicit count labels and do not contain raw source paths, development-only source filenames, source-files paths, source_path values, browse targets, or download targets
Confirm document source_ids still resolve to source provenance stubs or retained regulatory sources
Confirm workspaces/epp-full/sources/regulatory remains present for CFR and Survey Guidance views
Run Senku Prep project-brain validation
Run git diff --check

changed_surfaces: scripts/import_epp_workspace.py now builds a hidden staged candidate, validates it, appends a sanitized audit event, and promotes only after checks pass
scripts/check_epp_workspace_references.py adds the repeatable reference-integrity check
workspaces/epp-full was refreshed as sanitized app-facing workspace metadata plus retained regulatory sources and preserved app-owned state

validation_commands.evidence: Imported 261 documents into epp-full; 47 provenance-only source records, 16 retained regulatory sources, 2 preserved app-state files, and 0 seeded workbook sidecars.

evidence: A first staged candidate failed the source-leak check before live promotion, leaving the live workspace untouched and with no success audit event appended.
workspaces/epp-full/source-files is absent after successful refresh.
workspaces/epp-full/sources/regulatory is present after successful refresh.
workspaces/epp-full/workspace.json uses explicit document_count, provenance_source_count, and retained_regulatory_source_count fields without source_count or original source-file counters.
workspaces/epp-full/audit/ledger.jsonl contains one sanitized workspace_import_refreshed event with passed validation statuses.
Only epp-full and epp-seed workspace manifests are discoverable under workspaces.
residual_risks: Canonical Markdown document bodies were intentionally not scanned or rewritten by SG-0007, so future content review may still find historical worksheet or source-name mentions inside content.
One upstream catalog document path, DOC-EVACUATION-EVACUATION_FLOOR_PLANS, still has no corresponding canonical Markdown file; SG-0007 preserved catalog count rather than inventing missing content.

notes: This slice records the user's full-content decision and makes the import refreshable rather than a one-off copy. Source retention is now narrowed: retain canonical EPP documents plus regulatory sources used by the app, but physically remove the development-only original office/catalog source-files folder from the app-facing workspace. The app-facing catalog is normalized in place; do not keep a raw upstream catalog copy with original file paths inside Archivist v1. All app-facing project metadata copied into the workspace should be sanitized so original office/catalog paths do not leak through crosswalks, metadata panels, search, compliance, or future service responses. App-facing provenance should keep source kind, branch, commit, and a non-browseable label without exposing absolute local checkout paths. Original catalog source records remain only as non-browseable provenance stubs so document source_ids do not dangle or imply retained files. Development-only original source annotations should be removed or normalized rather than retained as app-facing extracted context; retained regulatory extracted context remains allowed. The cleanup requires a repeatable leak check that fails on disallowed original-source markers while allowing retained regulatory source data, plus an integrity check that fails on dangling references to removed source annotations or removed raw paths. Import summaries should use explicit source count fields instead of bare source_count so provenance-only records are not confused with retained files. The leak check should not scan canonical Markdown document bodies under content. Normal import refresh should build and validate a staged candidate before promoting imported surfaces into the live epp-full workspace. Promotion should preserve app-owned audit, workbook, draft, and runtime state; missing workbook sidecars may be seeded non-destructively. Successful refresh should append a sanitized import event to the audit ledger and print a matching console summary without retaining raw source paths or development-only source details. Failed candidate import or validation should leave the live workspace usable and append no success audit event. It is now the build prerequisite for SG-0013 so the browser shell starts from the cleaned app-facing workspace.
